currentParagraphText: “I win,” Jake said with a smile.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I win,” Jake said with a smile.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “For now,” Minaga said, crossing his arms. “Just know that should you ever set foot in Nevermore again, we will throw the book at you and go for maximum sentencing. Which is to say nothing, as I’m pretty sure killing things inside of Nevermore isn’t actually illegal.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Minaga and Jake both, for some reason, turned to the Sword Saint, who’d been appointed judge. The two of them had likely thought the gag would end there, but the old man ended up shaking his head. “I do not believe I have the jurisdiction to even make a ruling. Even if I do, the crime happened in Nevermore, and unless the Pantheon of Life has an extradition agreement, I find it questionable if any prosecution can ever take place.”
